segments.name: Shipping
segments.description: Operates owned and chartered drybulk vessels for industrial customers worldwide, carrying commodities under voyage and time charters and contracts of affreightment.
segments.evidence: This segment provides seaborne dry bulk logistics and transportation services globally, primarily through voyage and time charter arrangements.

revenueModel.text: Industrial cargo owners and charterers pay the company to transport drybulk cargoes and to provide vessels under voyage and time charters.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenue is generated from the transportation of dry bulk cargoes using vessels that are either owned or chartered by the Company.
